description: This file contains upgrade-related functions for Buffalo devices, specifically for handling firmware updates, image validation, and U-Boot boot behavior. It includes logic for verifying images, handling NAND flash partitions, and device-specific operations.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image for Buffalo devices, checking TRX magic, tar archive validity, partition size compatibility, and ensuring the image is suitable for upgrade.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade steps for TRX + UBI formatted images, including cache clearing, UBI detachment, and writing the firmware image to NAND.

methods.name: buffalo_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines the image type and coordinates the upgrade process, delegating to appropriate functions based on image magic.
